Atelier.Hint: Preview: closed book. Changes apply instantly; saving stores them on the journal.
Atelier.SaveFailed: Saving failed — see console for details.
Atelier.ResetTitle: Reset all fields to defaults (not saved yet)

Field.Title: Title

Warn.GmOnly: Only the GM can open the atelier.
Warn.NoReadPermission: You lack permission to read this journal.

Reader.Title: Necronolib — Book
Reader.Empty: This book has no pages yet.
Reader.ShareTitle: Gives selected players permanent access via the Journal tab — they can only open it in reader view.
Reader.Unsupported: This page type is not shown in the book — please open it in the journal.
Reader.KeeperOnlyOn: Keeper only — click to reveal to players
Reader.KeeperOnlyOff: Visible to players — click to make keeper only
Reader.Following: You are following the keeper's reading
Reader.ShowTitle: Opens the book in reader view for all connected players. They follow your page turns until you click “Stop showing”.
Reader.ShowNoPlayers: No players connected — the book opens for players who are online now.
Reader.MissingAccess: These connected players lack read access: {names}. Share the book with them (permanent, reader view only)?
Reader.ShareDialogHint: Selected players see the book permanently in the Journal tab and can only open it in reader view. Unselecting revokes access.

Io.NoCoc7Books: No CoC7 book items found in world or compendiums.
Io.NothingSelected: Please choose a file or a CoC7 book.
Io.NotJson: The file is not valid JSON.
Io.UnknownFormat: Unknown format — expected a Necronolib book or CoC7 book item.
Io.LinkNotFound: CoC7 book “{name}” not found — imported without link.
Io.CreatedFromCoc7: Book “{journal}” created from CoC7 item and linked.
